items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I got out the Dexter Gordon thing...

ctx.x: [sings] How I have tried, this feeling inside, can’t be denied, so what if it’s done — it’s home. That’s “Fried Bananas.”

That’s right. You get to move on to the next round. You know when I read that about “Fried Bananas” I got out the Dexter Gordon thing and first of all I thought she’s going to have the term “fried bananas” in the lyrics because of the story that went with it. Then I listened to the whole thing and it’s quite clever and quite an accomplishment.
You did hear the whole story of my husband saying, “I’ve not seen you at the piano anymore?” © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
